annualRule: USD annual reference is ten times USD monthly; local storefront price points must be checked independently
localization: Use Apple storefront currencies and comparable local price points. Display the actual localized StoreKit price. Do not reuse the internal BRL 4.99 illustration as a store exchange-rate policy.
constraints: No approval of new provider spending or automatic recharge
No automatic sale of unconfigured products
Languages, territories, metadata and purchase tests are separate release requirements
No deployment or store publication approved by this pricing record alone
